title: How are mem like noodles the ultimate jokebook anout men
summary: This is a short jokebook of ten one-line riddles and punchlines that poke fun at men and the stereotypes often applied to them. The jokes cover familiar ground: a man's idea of a romantic evening, his supposed help around the house, the comparison between men and E.T., the trouble with men getting lost in space, and what a man counts as a seven-course meal. Each joke is a question followed by a short answer, written for a light, teasing tone. The text ends with a copyright notice from Newport House, dated 1991, and a request that readers pass the jokes along to other bulletin boards with the title and copyright intact, since the publisher is a small family-owned firm. The excerpt gives no author names, so the compiler is unknown. The book is aimed at general readers who enjoy gag-style humor and is meant to be read quickly, one joke at a time.
